paper.excerpt: This set of images is denoted M0◦.
To create ﬁve additional domains the images in M0◦are rotated by 15, 30, 45, 60 and 75 degrees.
In order to evaluate their domain generalization abilities, models are trained on ﬁve domains and tested on the remaining 6th domain, e.g., train on M0◦, M15◦, M30◦, M45◦and M60◦, test on M75◦.
Here, we trained DIVA on 5000 images from ﬁve domains: M0◦, M15◦, M30◦, M45◦and M60◦.
